description: React component for managing and displaying document stores, including search, view toggling, pagination, and dialogs.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles toggling between 'card' and 'list' view styles, updating local storage and state.

methods.name: filterDocStores
methods.description: Filters document store data based on search input matching name or description.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search state based on user input.

methods.name: goToDocumentStore
methods.description: Navigates to a specific document store page by ID.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Prepares and shows dialog for adding a new document store.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Handles confirmation of adding a new document store and refreshes data.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Fetches document store data with current pagination parameters.
